deploy.//cronSchedule: Wakes the runner across BOTH offsets: 05:00–07:00 America/Los_Angeles = 12:00–14:59 UTC (PDT) and 13:00–15:59 UTC (PST). Hours 12–15 UTC is the DST-safe superset. The APP's LA gate (withinMorningWindow, 05:00–07:00) is authoritative and decides whether any dispatch is allowed; the cron only wakes the runner and never defines the true window.
